description: For positive n, k, and m, R(n,k,m) is the least N at least m for which every k-colouring of n-element subsets of the N-element initial segment has a homogeneous m-element subset.
signature: Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.ramseyNumber (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : 0 < m) : ℕ
